info.description: API for Esports Club Reservation system
info.title: Esports Club Booking API

get.description: Returns a list of bookings with various statuses

post.description: Creates a new booking with the provided start and end times, computer ID and user ID

get.description: Returns a list of active bookings
get.summary: Get active bookings with time format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"

get.description: Returns a list of all bookings
Returns a list of cancelled bookings
get.summary: Get cancelled bookings with time format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"

get.description: Returns a list of finished bookings
get.summary: Get finished bookings with time format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"

get.description: Returns a list of pending bookings
get.summary: Get pending bookings with time format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"

post.description: Cancels a booking with the given ID. The user must have the correct role to cancel the booking.

400.description: Invalid booking ID or non own booking cancel

get.description: Returns a list of all computers
Returns a list of computers with the remaining time (in seconds) each will be occupied before becoming available for booking with the specified package.
get.summary: Get remaining occupied time for all computers

parameters.description: ID of the package used to calculate remaining occupied time
parameters.name: packageID

200.description: List of computers and their remaining occupied time

get.description: Returns a list of all computer statuses
Returns a specific Computer by ID

delete.description: Deletes a specific computer by ID

get.description: Returns a list of bookings for the specified computer ID
get.summary: Get bookings for a specific computer with time format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00"

200.description: List of bookings for the computer

get.description: Returns the remaining time (in seconds) that a specific computer will be occupied before it becomes available for a new booking with the given package duration.
get.summary: Get remaining occupied time for a computer

parameters.description: ID of the computer to check availability for
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: ID of the package whose duration will be used in the calculation
parameters.name: packageID

200.description: Remaining time the computer is occupied

400.description: Invalid computer ID or package ID

get.description: Returns the status of the specified computer ID
get.summary: Get the status of a specific computer

get.description: Returns a list of all packages
Returns a list of all users
Returns a list of bookings for the specified user ID
get.summary: Get bookings for a specific user

200.description: List of bookings for the user

500.description: Internal server error or unhandled error

delete.description: Deletes a user with the given ID.

post.description: Blocks a user with the given ID.
Unblocks a user with the given ID.
Sends a verification code to the email provided in request body
post.summary: Send verification code to user's email

get.description: Returns the user's data if they are authorized
Returns a 200 status if user is privileged

post.description: Resets user's password using email, code and new password
Sends a password reset code to the user's email

400.description: Invalid request or user not found

post.description: Login user with email, login and password, returns JWT token

204.description: No Content, JWT set in HTTPOnly cookie

401.description: Unauthorized, invalid credentials or blocked user

post.description: Registers a user with email, login and password
Verifies user's email using a verification code

computer_id.description:
ComputerID is the ID of the computer being booked.
required: true

end_time.description:
EndTime is the end time of the booking in RFC3339 format.
required: true

package_id.description:
PackageID is the ID of the selected package for the booking.
required: true

start_time.description:
StartTime is the start time of the booking in RFC3339 format.
required: true

user_id.description:
UserID is the ID of the user making the booking.
required: true
